human_goal: The human can open many fresh chats with the same worker bootstrap. Workers think with the same strategic posture as the guide, self-assign distinct or intentionally complementary work, continue through sequential checkpoints, recover stalled work, create useful work when prepared queues drain, and locally integrate page work so the global guide is not the routine bottleneck.

allocator_rules: Normal READY work uses exclusive create-if-absent claim.
BLOCKED_DEPENDENCY becomes derived READY when its activation rule is proven from exact dependency returns; parent file editing is not required just to unblock it.
After each RETURN a worker reloads current state and may claim any newly-unblocked sequential successor. If another worker already claimed it, choose another useful lane.
When prepared work is exhausted, DISCOVERY mode may atomically pin a deduplicated proposal and create useful future work instead of defaulting to idle.
If a stalled attempt is recovery-eligible, RECOVER may outrank new low-value discovery.
Fresh critics are inserted by evidence/risk triggers, not ritual chat counts.
No worker count target is itself success; useful durable results per human intervention is the primary objective.
non_parallelizable_rules: Shared authority promotion remains separate and sequential.
The exact same exclusive mutation scope cannot have two live owners.
Cross-surface shared-owner conflicts require reconciliation before mutation.
Human Accepted / irreversible / credential / private boundaries remain human or specifically authorized.
truth_boundary: This plan and the 52 READY lanes make a broad high-parallelism canary possible now. They do not by themselves prove that 50+ workers are safe/productive or that timed stale takeover is unattended. Those claims require the S4 evidence gate; fully unattended timed recovery additionally requires an external metabolism runtime.
